notes: Reconciliation-only. Executed by src/validate_campaign_funnel.py, which independently recomputes every campaign's funnel counts in pandas (never importing src/etl_spark_campaign_funnel.py's Spark logic) and compares against the curated table it wrote.

The 7 *_reconciliation rules below check PORTFOLIO-WIDE totals (summed across all campaigns + the organic row) -- campaign_funnel_row_counts_match_per_campaign is the stronger check that every individual campaign's row matches exactly, not just the totals.

rules.description: Total emails_sent across all curated campaign_funnel rows must match the count of SENT email_events.
Total emails_opened across all curated campaign_funnel rows must match the count of OPENED email_events.
Total emails_clicked across all curated campaign_funnel rows must match the count of CLICKED email_events.
Total offers_created across all curated campaign_funnel rows must match the total row count of prequal_offers.
Total applications_submitted across all curated campaign_funnel rows must match the total row count of applications.
Total applications_approved across all curated campaign_funnel rows must match the count of APPROVED underwriting_decisions.
Total loans_funded across all curated campaign_funnel rows must match the total row count of loans.

Every individual campaign_id's (including the organic/NULL row's) funnel counts AND rates (open_rate, click_through_rate, click_to_offer_rate, offer_to_application_rate, application_to_approval_rate, approval_to_funded_rate) must match an independent per-campaign pandas recomputation, not just the portfolio-wide totals -- rates are checked separately from counts because a bug in the rate FORMULA itself (e.g. a swapped numerator/denominator) would not show up in the count-only checks.
